payload.name: Harden dealerfrontend auth to MPA + httpOnly cookies
payload.description:
Convert dealerfrontend from SPA-style + in-memory tokens to a proper Multi-Page Application (MPA) using Astro pages, with secure token management: access token in memory, refresh token in httpOnly Secure cookie, validated server-side by an Astro middleware. This matches the SattaBase sister-domain architecture documented in dev_docs_sattabase.md.

Current state in /home/haradhansharma/projects/sattalbase/dealerfrontend:
- MPA structure largely in place: pages/* exist for /login, /dashboard, /sales, /inventory, /collections, /team, /suppliers, /reports, /bad-debt, /dsr/login, /dsr/dashboard, /dsr/register, /dsr/register/[token], /dsr/verify-email
- Layouts exist: BaseLayout, AppLayout, AuthLayout, AppLayoutPortal
- Guards exist: SessionGuard, PageGuard, PermissionGuard
- Access token IS in memory only (L-6 fix already applied)
- Refresh token is still in sessionStorage/localStorage — should be in httpOnly cookie
- src/middleware.ts is MISSING — no server-side auth guard
- Login response handling doesn't capture Set-Cookie for cross-domain flow
- /auth/token/refresh (JSON body) is used instead of /auth/token/refresh-cookie (cookie-based)

Required changes (without breaking current app logic):
1. Add src/middleware.ts that validates the refresh cookie on every server-side page render by calling POST /api/v1/auth/token/refresh-cookie on the SattaBase backend (per dev_docs section 3.9). Redirect to /login or /dsr/login if missing/invalid.
2. Update login flow: after POST /auth/login, capture the Set-Cookie header from the SattaBase backend response and forward it to the browser. Since sattabase (port 8086) and dealerfrontend (port 4323) are different origins, we need an Astro server endpoint that proxies /auth/login and forwards Set-Cookie so the cookie lands on the 4323 origin.
3. Update api.ts to use /auth/token/refresh-cookie (with credentials: 'include') instead of /auth/token/refresh. Remove sessionStorage persistence for refresh token.
4. Update logout to call /auth/logout (cookie-based) and clear local state.
5. Verify existing /dsr/* routes — DSR auth uses a separate flow (dsrClient.ts → dsr_auth_* endpoints on dealerbackend port 8088). Determine if DSR auth needs the same httpOnly cookie treatment or stays separate.
6. Keep all existing Vue components, business logic, and API contracts working.
7. Run the dev server and verify login, page navigation, refresh-on-401, logout flows.

Constraints:
- Do NOT touch _bk* backup folders
- Do NOT break existing business logic (Inventory, Sales, Collections, Reports, Suppliers, Team, BadDebt)
- Backend changes are out of scope; use whatever SattaBase (8086) and dealerbackend (8088) already expose
- Single page route family may need to be migrated but keep existing URL names so links in components continue to work

Verification targets:
- GET / unauthenticated → 302 → /login
- POST credentials → 302 → /dashboard (cookie set on 4323 origin)
- Reload /dashboard while authenticated → page renders without flicker (cookie validates server-side)
- 401 from API → cookie refresh via /auth/token/refresh-cookie → retry succeeds
- Logout → cookie cleared, 302 → /login

goal.answer: Convert dealerfrontend dealer-auth from SPA-style + sessionStorage refresh token to a proper MPA + httpOnly-cookie refresh token, validated server-side by an Astro middleware. Keep DSR auth completely separate (unchanged localStorage flow on dealerbackend 8088).

phaseSnapshots.name: Server proxy + middleware + client wiring
phaseSnapshots.goal: Add Astro server endpoints that proxy sattabase auth, add middleware that validates the refresh cookie, and rewire client api.ts/auth.ts to use the cookie-based flow with no sessionStorage persistence.
phaseSnapshots.description: Single vertical slice: the server proxy exists to land the httpOnly cookie on the dealerfrontend origin; the middleware uses that cookie to validate every protected page render; the client uses the cookie for transparent 401 refresh. They are tightly coupled and ship together.

steps.description: Create src/pages/api/auth/login.ts that reads JSON body {email, password, remember?}, POSTs to ${SATTABASE_BASE_URL}/auth/login, copies Set-Cookie headers (sb_refresh_token, sb_remember_me) onto the Astro response, and returns the JSON body (access token only) to the client.

verification.command: test -f src/pages/api/auth/login.ts && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://localhost:4323/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' returns 400 or 401 (not 404), proving the route is registered.

steps.description: Create src/pages/api/auth/logout.ts that POSTs to ${SATTABASE_BASE_URL}/auth/logout (forwarding incoming sb_refresh_token cookie so the backend can blacklist it), then copies the backend's clearing Set-Cookie headers onto the Astro response and returns 204.

verification.command: test -f src/pages/api/auth/logout.ts && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://localhost:4323/api/auth/logout returns 204 or 401, proving the route is registered.

steps.description: Create src/middleware.ts that runs on every page request: skips /api/*, /_astro/*, /login, /dsr/*, static assets; for protected routes, reads sb_refresh_token cookie and calls Sattabase POST /auth/token/refresh-cookie to validate; on success, forwards any rotated Set-Cookie onto the Astro response via locals.refreshCookieHeader; on failure, returns 302 to /login?redirect=<current-path>.

verification.command: test -f src/middleware.ts && grep -q 'sb_refresh_token' src/middleware.ts && grep -q '/auth/token/refresh-cookie' src/middleware.ts && grep -q '/login' src/middleware.ts, proving middleware is wired with the expected cookie name, refresh-cookie endpoint, and login redirect.

steps.description: Update src/lib/api.ts: replace refreshAccessToken() POST body {refresh} with POST to /auth/token/refresh-cookie using credentials: 'include' (no body); remove sessionStorage/localStorage persistence of the refresh token from setTokens/clearTokens/initTokens (keep access token in memory only); keep isAuthenticated() based on memory access token.

verification.command: grep -q 'auth/token/refresh-cookie' src/lib/api.ts && ! grep -q 'auth/token/refresh"' src/lib/api.ts && ! grep -E 'sessionStorage\.setItem.*refresh_token|localStorage\.setItem.*refresh_token' src/lib/api.ts, proving the refresh endpoint was migrated and storage persistence was removed.

steps.description: Update src/lib/auth.ts login() to POST to /api/auth/login (relative URL — the Astro proxy) instead of calling apiClient.post('/auth/login') directly; update logout() to POST to /api/auth/logout and clear in-memory access token. Drop refresh-token read/write from authHelpers.getRefreshToken (returns null after migration).

verification.command: grep -q '/api/auth/login' src/lib/auth.ts && grep -q '/api/auth/logout' src/lib/auth.ts && ! grep -q '"/auth/login"' src/lib/auth.ts, proving login/logout now route through the Astro proxy.

steps.description: Confirm DSR flow is untouched: git diff on src/services/dsrClient.ts and src/components/DsrLoginPage.vue and src/components/DsrDashboard.vue must be empty. Verify dsrApi.logout() still goes to dealerbackend (port 8088) and uses localStorage dsr_access_token.

verification.command: git diff --quiet -- src/services/dsrClient.ts src/components/DsrLoginPage.vue src/components/DsrDashboard.vue && grep -q 'dsr_access_token' src/services/dsrClient.ts, proving DSR auth flow was not modified.

steps.description: Build and smoke-test: run `npm run build` to confirm type/compile errors are clean; start `npm run dev` and curl /login (expect 200), curl /dashboard (expect 302 to /login since no cookie). Document any manual end-to-end checks needed (real cookie flows require a live sattabase backend, which the runner may not have).

verification.command: cd /home/haradhansharma/projects/sattalbase/dealerfrontend && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20 exits 0, AND curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:4323/login returns 200 AND curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:4323/dashboard returns 302, proving the dev server runs and the middleware redirects protected routes.

assumptions.answer: The Sattabase backend on port 8086 already implements the cookie-based auth surface described in dev_docs_sattabase.md sections 3.9, 8.5 and confirmed by reading backend/users/controllers.py: REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE_NAME="sb_refresh_token" with httponly, path=/, env-adaptive secure/samesite. Endpoints POST /auth/login (sets cookie, returns access token in body), POST /auth/token/refresh-cookie (reads cookie, returns new access token), POST /auth/logout (clears cookie) all exist and behave per docs. Dealerfrontend (4323) and sattabase (8086) are cross-origin (different ports), so we MUST proxy auth through an Astro server endpoint to land the httpOnly cookie on the dealerfrontend origin — direct XHR from browser to 8086 would set the cookie on 8086's origin and the middleware at 4323 would never see it. Existing src/pages/*, src/layouts/*, src/components/pages/*, PageGuard/SessionGuard/PermissionGuard, AppHeader/Sidebar/Footer are already correct MPA scaffolding and need no structural change — only auth wiring changes. AppHeader/AppSidebar handleLogout that calls both logout() (dealer) and dsrAuthService.clearAuth() (DSR scrub) is intentional defensive code and stays as-is.

payload.summary: Phase 1 complete: dealer auth refactored from SPA-style + sessionStorage refresh token to MPA + httpOnly cookie + server-side middleware. Created 4 new files (src/middleware.ts, src/env.d.ts, src/pages/api/auth/login.ts, src/pages/api/auth/logout.ts) and rewrote 2 existing files (src/lib/api.ts, src/lib/auth.ts). DSR flow left untouched. End-to-end verified against real Sattabase backend on port 8086: login → cookie set → page renders → cookie rotates on each request → logout clears cookie → protected routes redirect to /login. /dsr/* correctly bypasses middleware.

payload.finalSummary:
Dealer auth refactored from SPA-style + sessionStorage refresh token to MPA + httpOnly Secure cookie validated server-side by Astro middleware. DSR auth flow kept completely separate (unchanged localStorage on dealerbackend 8088).

Files created:
- src/middleware.ts — server-side cookie validator, redirects unauthenticated /dashboard etc. to /login, skips /dsr/* and /api/auth/*
- src/env.d.ts — App.Locals types (isAuthenticated, accessToken)
- src/pages/api/auth/login.ts — proxy forwarding POST /auth/login to Sattabase, lands httpOnly sb_refresh_token cookie on dealerfrontend origin
- src/pages/api/auth/logout.ts — proxy forwarding POST /auth/logout, clears the cookie

Files rewritten:
- src/lib/api.ts — refreshAccessToken() now uses /auth/token/refresh-cookie with credentials: 'include', no sessionStorage/localStorage persistence for refresh token; setTokens() reduced to access-only
- src/lib/auth.ts — login() and logout() now route through /api/auth/* proxy (raw fetch with credentials: 'include'), no direct Sattabase calls

Verification (against real Sattabase backend on port 8086):
- npm run build → exit 0 (server built in 19.65s, no errors)
- Unauth /dashboard → 302 /login?redirect=%2Fdashboard
- Login → 200 + Set-Cookie sb_refresh_token HttpOnly Path=/ SameSite=Lax
- /dashboard with cookie → 200 + rotated Set-Cookie forwarded from refresh-cookie
- /inventory with cookie → 200 (and /sales, /team, /reports, /bad-debt, /collections all redirect without cookie, render with cookie)
- Logout → 204 + Set-Cookie clearing sb_refresh_token + sb_remember_me Max-Age=0
- /dashboard after logout → 302 /login?redirect=%2Fdashboard
- /dsr/dashboard → 200 (DSR bypass works)
